description: Supplier-verification agents that turn their own proven judgments into SQL rules Zetaris enforces.

zetaris.role: The only data layer: a Postgres ERP as a JDBC data source, GLEIF and SEC EDGAR records as REST tables the agents create at runtime, a cached company_dns SIC list, and one federated query per supplier that also evaluates the learned rules

engines.name: World Model
engines.feature: Resolver entity matching: name normalisation, similarity and banding of GLEIF candidates

engines.name: H-MEM
engines.feature: Rule Smith: the Judge's verdicts as memories, dreaming, and the trust ledger of rule promotions and demotions

nightshift.role: The only AI provider: every model call, on the meterless/deep route, with the answering model logged per request

nvidia.role: Nemotron 3 Ultra, through Nightshift's deep lane, is the Judge: it rules on each fact and scores its verdicts

cursor.role: Built in Cursor with its agent, in reviewed, tested slices

pre_existing_components: app/engines/hmem/src and app/engines/world-model/src: Meterless reference implementations (Apache-2.0), unchanged
tests/conformance: the official Meterless conformance suites
